description: This file contains internal helper templates and functions for type introspection, callable checks, and equivalence testing within the Abseil C++ library, specifically related to conformance testing helpers.

classes.name: GeneratorType
classes.description: A template struct representing a function object that returns an instance of a type under conformance testing.

classes.name: EquivalenceClassType
classes.description: A template struct representing a group of generator functions with the same return type, used for conformance testing.

classes.name: IsNullaryCallable
classes.description: A template struct to check if a functor can be called with no arguments.

classes.name: IsEquivalenceClass
classes.description: A type trait to determine if a type is a specialization of EquivalenceClassType.

classes.name: OrderedEquivalenceClasses
classes.description: A template struct representing an ordered sequence of EquivalenceClassType instances.

classes.name: ResultOfGenerator
classes.description: A metafunction to determine the return type of a GeneratorType functor.

classes.name: AreGeneratorsWithTheSameReturnType
classes.description: A metafunction to check if multiple generator functors have the same return type.

classes.name: AreEquivalenceClassesOfTheSameType
classes.description: A metafunction to verify if multiple EquivalenceClassType specializations contain generator functions with the same return type.

classes.name: ForEachParameter
classes.description: A utility to execute a function on each parameter passed.

classes.name: ForEachTupleElement
classes.description: A utility to execute a function on each element of a tuple.

classes.name: ForEveryTwo
classes.description: A utility to execute a function on every pair of elements in a tuple, including self-pairs.

classes.name: InsertEach
classes.description: A template function to insert multiple values into a container.

classes.name: If
classes.description: A template struct with static Invoke method to conditionally execute a callable based on a boolean template parameter.
